messages:
Maya Lin: Exec weekly — quick note and three priorities: (1) Harden production SLAs, (2) finalize Private deployment security defaults, (3) accelerate predictable unit-cost wins. Brief and actionable this week.

Omar Haddad: can you expand on "security defaults"? are we changing defaults for new Private installs?

Maya Lin: Yesdefault for new Private deployments will require customer-managed KMS OR use our managed KMS with enforced envelope encryption. This is to simplify audits for regulated customers. Existing installs are grandfathered for 60 days to migrate. Security will publish migration steps.

Claire Dubois: product + CE note: we'll add a migration toggle in Console and an API endpoint so customers can opt-in to immediate migration. CE wants a test harness for pilots.

ops-bot: 2234561256 Incident: autoscaler flapping in eu-central-1 (03:12 - 03:25 UTC). Impact: brief lat increases for batch-heavy routes (~0.6% requests slowed). Root cause: aggressive scale-down threshold interacting with a daemon restart. Remediated: adjusted cooldown and restarted controller. Incident resolved.

Maya Lin: thanks ops-bot. Claire/Omar: please own the postmortem and add a pre-merge test for scale-down cooldowns. Exec wants a 1-paragraph blameless summary by Friday.

Omar Haddad: will do. I'll add a regression test in the autoscaler suite and push a canary tomorrow.

Claire Dubois: CE and Product will update the pilot runbook to include scale-down guidance.

Maya Lin: on SLAs: target p95 <= 140ms hosted, error budget <= 0.4% for core inference routes. If any service crosses 25% of budget in a week, flag for exec triage within 12h.

Omar Haddad: infra note: recent kernel tuning reduced tail for long-seq requests; we saw ~9% p95 improvement in canary. We'll expand to dedicated pools after tests.

Maya Lin: good. also note: Optimize team's first pass of adaptive batching shows a projected 7% token-cost reduction without quality regression on our eval set. Prioritize quality gating.

Claire Dubois: Sales/CS update: Private signups in APAC now include 2 regulated pilots; legal requires the KMS default plus data residency confirmation. We'll need the migration docs ASAP.

Maya Lin: approved: legal + security to publish migration doc and an FAQ. Comms-bot, prepare a short customer note.

comms-bot: Draft created: "Private deployments: KMS defaults & migration timeline". Will route for review.

Maya Lin: org asks: 1) Pause non-blocker infra experiments for 3 weeks in production; security patches only with patch plan. 2) Each team to post a single reliability or cost OKR by next Tue. 3) Exec will review Private canary checklist before region rollouts.

Omar Haddad: noted. I'll circulate infra freeze guidance and exceptions process.

Claire Dubois: product will post the CE playbook and migration steps to #templates by Mon.

Maya Lin: quick wins this week: hosted p95 trimmed ~9% in canaries, two small pilots signed for APAC Private, and adaptive batching shows promising cost wins. Keep updates short and escalate anything that risks SLAs. Thanks all :seedling:
